issues.quote: A man struck like that would have known very little about it. It would have been very quick.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about the assailant's sex or about how long the blow or death took.
issues.misreading: A solver could take 'A man' as a fact that the killer was male, which could rule out Madame or others. 'Very quick' could be read as a duration hint about the attack or death that the sheet does not support.

issues.quote: The regulator on the wall had stopped. I thought, God forgive me, that it had stopped with its master.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator, its stopping, or when it stopped.
issues.misreading: A solver could read 'stopped with its master' as implying the regulator stopped at the moment of death, giving a time of death or a clock reading that is not in the sheet.

issues.quote: He had his repeater in his hand.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no reading from the repeater watch, and says nothing about whether it was running or stopped.
issues.misreading: A repeater chimes the time on demand, so a solver could read this as a hint that the victim's watch gave a reading at the time of death.
